# The error builtin and error propagation.

=== error raises
(error "boom")
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message boom

=== error needs a string
(error 1)
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message error expects a string message: expected string, got number

=== error needs a message
(error)
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message error expects 1 argument (a message string)

=== error takes exactly one
(error "a" "b")
--- error
--- at 1:1
--- message error expects 1 argument (a message string)

=== error inside a branch not taken does not raise
(if #t 1 (error "no"))
--- want
1

=== error inside a function propagates
(do (def f (fn (x) (if (< x 0) (error "negative") x))) (f -1))
--- error
--- at 1:32
--- message negative

=== error not raised on the happy path
(do (def f (fn (x) (if (< x 0) (error "negative") x))) (f 1))
--- want
1

=== error inside map propagates
(map (fn (x) (if (> x 2) (error "big") x)) (list 1 2 3))
--- error
--- at 1:26
--- message big

=== error stops later side effects
(do (set a 1) (error "stop") (set a 2))
--- error
--- at 1:15
--- message stop

=== unknown builtin is an undefined global
(no-such-function 1)
--- error
--- at 1:2
--- message undefined global: no-such-function
